title: Describe. Show. Prove.
text: Describe what should happen. Show what happened. Prove whether they match. Reality Compiler turns physical procedures into inspectable requirements and evidence-backed verdicts.

title: Intention becomes an inspectable program
text: The block must enter the marked region before the cup. Muse Wonder compiled this original instruction. Independent semantic validation checks its meaning: typed predicates, object identities, and an explicit ordering constraint.

title: Bind identities once
text: Select the objects and region in frame zero. This earlier application screenshot shows selection on generated input.

title: Actual captured SAM 3.1 tracking
text: These are actual captured SAM masks and tracks on generated footage, reviewed offline. Deterministic geometry converts tracks into region-entry observations. This demonstration makes no new model requests.

title: PASS needs inspectable evidence
text: The original procedure passes. Both entries have evidence intervals, and the block enters first. Click a timestamp to inspect its supporting frames. Confidence alone cannot establish the required order.

title: Inspect the source; preserve timing boundaries
text: New uploads also map normalized evidence to original decoded source frames. This separate generated-input run uses local OpenCV, not SAM. The older Meta capture correctly remains labeled unmapped.

title: Change the requirement, keep the evidence
text: Now enter a new procedure: cup before block. It compiles independently with local rules. Evaluate the same evidence. No tracking or visual model is run again.

title: One recording. PASS and FAIL.
text: Same recording. Opposite requirement. The revision fails because the saved observations prove the reverse order. Side-by-side checks explain the contradiction, while matching perception fingerprints establish evidence reuse.

title: Missing proof stays UNKNOWN
text: Add a sterile-cup requirement. The visible order still holds, but these pixels cannot establish sterility. The actual result is unknown. Unsupported requirements stay explicit instead of disappearing into a confident answer.

title: Model interpretation and judgment stay separate
text: Original Wonder compilation and SAM tracking retain separate provenance. New revisions are local. Spark supports bounded final-state interpretation in other captured runs; it did not contribute to this ordering comparison.

title: Reusable evidence. Independently verifiable procedures.
text: For robotics and procedure review, inspect the proof, change the requirement, and check again. Reality Compiler: reusable evidence for independently verifiable physical procedures.
